source: Department of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries of Preah Vihear Province (មន្ទីរកសិកម្ម រុក្ខាប្រមាញ់ និងនេសាទ ខេត្តព្រះវិហារ), presentation "ដំណើរការផលិតកម្មគ្រាប់ពូជស្រូវសុទ្ធ" (Process of Pure Rice Seed Production), presented by Ms. Yem Sokey (យឹម សុគី), Deputy Head of the Office of Agricultural Techniques and Agricultural Productivity, dated 20 November 2017. Contact: ysophy168@gmail.com, 012 558 312.
text:
Sun-drying threshed seed: wait for a clear, sunny day and spread the threshed grain out evenly and thinly on mats to dry it down to a safe moisture level before storage. Drying generally takes about 3 days of sun exposure; grain should be spread thinly on mats (not directly on bare ground) and turned/stirred periodically so it dries evenly. Grain should not be piled too thickly, and drying directly on a concrete/cement floor should be avoided because it can make the grain overheat, leading to cracked or broken kernels. When drying a large quantity at once, spread it into a thin layer, about 3-5 cm thick, to promote even drying. Seed moisture content after drying, before it is bagged for storage, should be brought down to no more than 14% moisture.

Storage preparation: before bagging seed for storage, it must be winnowed/sifted (e.g., in a basket) to thoroughly remove any remaining impurities or foreign matter mixed in with the grain. Stored seed should be kept away from dampness and heat, since these conditions cause seed quality to decline through mold growth and insect pest damage; seed should be stored in a well-ventilated location, ideally elevated off the ground.
